areas.title: Antibiotic testing
areas.description: How a plate test becomes a measurement a person can review.

areas.title: Imaging & measurement
areas.description: Cameras, light, scale and the limits of what an image can tell us.

areas.title: AI & computer vision
areas.description: How software may assist, and how its reliability must be tested.

areas.title: Validation & standards
areas.description: Reference methods, human review, safety and clinical evidence.

areas.title: Instruments & engineering
areas.description: The proposed reader, sensors, controls and instrument family.

areas.title: Data & connected records
areas.description: Traceability, privacy, software interfaces and digital models.

areas.title: Microbiology & public health
areas.description: A range of research questions and possible future uses.

areas.title: People & development
areas.description: The project, service ideas, costs and staged development.

topics.title: Reader V1 and the laboratory workflow
text: A plate reader would photograph an antibiotic test and help a laboratory professional measure and review it. The first goal is a clearer record of a familiar laboratory method.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 11–15: Reader V1 and the laboratory workflow. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Reading guide and maturity language
text: A guide to the difference between an idea, an early prototype and a tested product. It helps readers understand how strong each project claim is.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 1–10: Reading guide and maturity language. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Instrument research families
text: Different instruments suit different jobs. This research compares a simple plate reader with more complex future systems for imaging, sensing and automation.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 16–19: Instrument research families. Internal project reference.

topics.title: PIMS, analysis and laboratory connectivity
text: The proposed Plate Information Management System would keep images, measurements and review decisions together, then share them with other laboratory software.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 20–22: PIMS, analysis and laboratory connectivity. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Laboratory and research services
text: A useful laboratory system also needs installation, training, maintenance and support. These service ideas are being considered alongside the instrument itself.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 23–27: Laboratory and research services. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Partner perspectives and portfolio development
text: Laboratories, researchers, institutions and investors have different needs. This area explores those needs and how they could shape development.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 28–34: Partner perspectives and portfolio development. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Measurement architecture and sensor selection
text: A sensor is useful only if it measures the right thing reliably. This area compares measurement needs before choosing cameras or other hardware.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 35–42: Measurement architecture and sensor selection. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Imaging and spectral sensing
text: Different colours and wavelengths of light can reveal different features in a sample. Research is needed to determine which signals add useful information.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 43–52: Imaging and spectral sensing. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Optical, thermal and impedance sensing
text: Light, temperature and electrical measurements are possible ways to study a sample. Each would need its own calibration and comparison with a trusted method.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 53–62: Optical, thermal and impedance sensing. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Chemical, gas and acoustic sensing
text: Gas, chemical and sound sensors may provide supporting information. None should be treated as proof of the organism’s identity without suitable evidence.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 63–72: Chemical, gas and acoustic sensing. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Environment, motion and instrument monitoring
text: Temperature, humidity, movement and instrument condition can affect measurements. Monitoring these factors would help explain unexpected results.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 73–82: Environment, motion and instrument monitoring. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Software, records, data and genomic provenance
text: Laboratory data need a clear history: where they came from, what changed and who reviewed them. Linking genetic results would require separate, qualified laboratory tests.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 83–91: Software, records, data and genomic provenance. Internal project reference.

topics.title: AI for acquisition, identity and zone boundaries
text: Computer vision may help locate plates, read identifiers and outline clear zones around antibiotic discs. Unclear images must remain visible to a reviewer.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 92–102: AI for acquisition, identity and zone boundaries. Internal project reference.

topics.title: AI for measurement, growth and early AST research
text: AI could help measure visible features or follow growth over time. Predicting an earlier antibiotic result is a separate research question that needs validation.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 103–112: AI for measurement, growth and early AST research. Internal project reference.

topics.title: AI for multimodal learning and model quality
text: Combining several types of measurement may help only if the model is tested on representative data. More inputs do not automatically make an answer better.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 113–122: AI for multimodal learning and model quality. Internal project reference.

topics.title: AI for review, operations and assistance
text: AI assistance could help people find records and review warnings. A qualified person remains responsible for accepting laboratory results.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 123–132: AI for review, operations and assistance. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Digital plate records and computational models
text: A digital plate record brings images and measurements together. A predictive digital twin goes further and remains a research goal, not a demonstrated biological forecast.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 133–142: Digital plate records and computational models. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Prediction, uncertainty and observation continuity
text: A missing observation and a prediction are not the same as a measurement. The project explores how to make these differences and their uncertainty easy to see.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 143–152: Prediction, uncertainty and observation continuity. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Simulation, validation and predictive twin research gates
text: Simulations can test software and ideas before real laboratory work. They cannot establish that an instrument or biological prediction works in practice.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 153–164: Simulation, validation and predictive twin research gates. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Clinical workflow applications
text: Potential clinical workflows include antibiotic testing and review. Each use would need a defined purpose, appropriate studies and any required clearance.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 165–170: Clinical workflow applications. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Heteroresistance research
text: A small group of bacteria may respond differently from the rest of a sample. Studying this variation requires suitable experiments, not a conclusion from one attractive image.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 171–178: Heteroresistance research. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Molecular, industrial and teaching applications
text: Possible future uses extend to molecular research, industrial quality checks and teaching. Their methods and validation needs differ from routine plate reading.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 179–188: Molecular, industrial and teaching applications. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Stewardship, public health and equitable access
text: Antibiotic stewardship means using antibiotics responsibly. Reliable laboratory records may support that work and public-health research after suitable validation and governance.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 189–196: Stewardship, public health and equitable access. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Measurement validation and study design
text: Validation asks how closely a new measurement agrees with a suitable reference, and when it fails. Studies must include difficult and unreadable cases.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 197–204: Measurement validation and study design. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Interpretation, usability and software validation
text: A useful result must be interpreted correctly and presented clearly. This includes checking the software, the applicable rules and how people use the interface.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 205–215: Interpretation, usability and software validation. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Privacy, security and AI assurance
text: Laboratory records can be sensitive. Proposed protections include controlled access, change history and checks on AI reliability.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 216–224: Privacy, security and AI assurance. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Clinical study preparation and release gates
text: Moving toward clinical use requires a study plan, safety evidence and clear acceptance criteria. A polished demonstration alone does not meet those requirements.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 225–228: Clinical study preparation and release gates. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Scientific evidence for measurement and biological research
text: Scientific literature helps explain measurement methods and biological limits. Evidence for a published method is not proof that AMReye.AI has achieved the same result.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 229–238: Scientific evidence for measurement and biological research. Internal project reference.

topics.title: AI evidence, comparators and unresolved propositions
text: Existing products and AI research provide useful comparisons. Open questions and differences in study conditions must remain visible.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 239–248: AI evidence, comparators and unresolved propositions. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Reader V1 engineering and dataset development
text: Early development focuses on the plate reader, representative images and repeatable measurements. A reliable dataset is as important as the interface.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 249–258: Reader V1 engineering and dataset development. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Manufacture, installation and service delivery
text: A laboratory product needs more than a working prototype. Manufacturing, installation, calibration, repairs and training all affect whether it can be used reliably.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 259–266: Manufacture, installation and service delivery. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Custom electronics, silicon and technology transfer
text: Custom electronics may become useful once measurement requirements are stable. Designing a custom chip too early can add cost without solving the main problem.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 267–270: Custom electronics, silicon and technology transfer. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Record interfaces and field dictionaries
text: A shared record format defines what fields mean. This helps prevent information from changing meaning when it moves between systems.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 271–279: Record interfaces and field dictionaries. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Worked record and recovery examples
text: Fictional examples show what happens when a result is corrected, a step fails or a connection is interrupted. They illustrate software behaviour, not clinical performance.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 280–282: Worked record and recovery examples. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Glossary and cross-reference index
text: Plain definitions help readers follow terms from microbiology, engineering and AI. Similar-sounding terms do not always describe the same thing.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 283–286: Glossary and cross-reference index. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Linked scientific and supplier bibliography
text: Scientific publications and supplier information provide background for project decisions. References should be read with their purpose, date and limitations in mind.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 287–292: Linked scientific and supplier bibliography. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Reader V1 development bill of materials
text: A development parts list helps plan a prototype. Supplier prices, compatibility and availability need checking before any purchase.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI Product and Research Compendium, pages 293–300: Reader V1 development bill of materials. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Executive summary
text: AMReye.AI explores AI-assisted antibiotic-test reading and a broader family of laboratory tools. The advanced workstation is a proposed direction, not an integrated clinical product.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-2: Executive summary. Internal project reference.

topics.title: What the flagship is · and is not
text: The flagship is a long-term instrument concept. It should not be confused with the smaller first prototype or the synthetic website demonstration.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-3: What the flagship is - and is not. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Positioning
text: The project starts with antibiotic susceptibility testing and explores wider laboratory automation. Other companies already work in imaging and automated testing.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-5: Positioning. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Why a flagship is necessary
text: A larger instrument concept helps examine how cameras, biology, software and safety could fit together. It is a way to plan development, not proof that every part already works.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-6: Why a flagship is necessary. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Design principles
text: Good design keeps measurements understandable, failures visible and people in control. These principles guide the proposed system.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-7: Design principles. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Current PoC, proposed flagship and future R&D
text: The current work is an early proof of concept. Proposed instruments and future research are labelled separately so visitors can see what still needs to be built and tested.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-8: Current PoC, proposed flagship and future R&D. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Full flagship architecture
text: The proposed system separates sample handling, measurement and computing. That separation would help keep heat, faults and software problems from affecting the sample.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-9: Full flagship architecture. Internal project reference.

topics.title: System architecture · editable block diagram
text: A system diagram shows how the instrument’s parts would connect. The connections describe a planned architecture, not a completed installation.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-10: System architecture - editable block diagram. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Data and control flow
text: Data would move from image capture through measurement and review. Each step should preserve enough history to explain how a result was reached.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-11: Data and control flow. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Dual imaging architecture
text: One imaging path may be optimised for accurate measurement and another for exploratory research. The benefit of this added complexity still needs evaluation.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-12: Dual imaging architecture. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Updated flagship hardware stack
text: Hardware choices depend on the measurement, maintenance and safety needs. Listed components are development references rather than a final product specification.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-13: Updated flagship hardware stack. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Jetson AGX Thor / T5000 rationale
text: A powerful edge computer is one possible platform for local AI processing. Its value depends on the actual workload, energy use and thermal design.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-14: Jetson AGX Thor / T5000 rationale. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Three-zone Bio-Vault chassis
text: The proposed enclosure separates biological work, instrument hardware and computing. The aim is to reduce interference and make servicing safer.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-16: Three-zone Bio-Vault chassis. Internal project reference.

topics.title: STM32-class Reflex controller
text: A small independent controller would handle time-sensitive controls and safety responses. It should not depend on the main AI computer staying responsive.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-17: STM32-class Reflex controller. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Industrial HMI / Interface computer
text: The operator display would help people run a workflow and review results. Clear controls and visible warnings matter more than decorative complexity.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-18: Industrial HMI / Interface computer. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Jetson Thor / T5000 Cortex
text: The proposed AI computer would process images near the instrument. Production hardware would need a separate engineering and reliability assessment.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-19: Jetson Thor / T5000 Cortex. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Clinical metrology camera
text: A measurement camera would capture the whole plate under controlled conditions. Accuracy depends on calibration and optics as well as camera resolution.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-20: Clinical metrology camera. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Whole-plate telecentric lens
text: A telecentric lens can reduce changes in apparent size when an object’s position varies. It is one optical option to evaluate for reliable measurement.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-21: Whole-plate telecentric lens. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Research RGB/NIR camera
text: A research camera could study visible and near-infrared light. Such observations would need validation before being used for biological conclusions.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-22: Research RGB/NIR camera. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Multimode illumination
text: Lighting a sample from different directions can reveal different features. Every selected lighting mode needs a defined measurement purpose.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-23: Multimode illumination. Internal project reference.

topics.title: BME690 VOC array
text: A gas-sensor array might detect changes in volatile chemicals near a sample. Those changes are not a standalone organism-identification test.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-24: BME690 VOC array. Internal project reference.

topics.title: VL53L8CX coarse ToF
text: A time-of-flight sensor estimates distance. It may help with positioning, but it is not a substitute for a precise surface-measurement instrument.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-25: VL53L8CX coarse ToF. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Research 3D profilometer
text: A surface scanner could study the three-dimensional shape of colonies. This remains a research direction with separate calibration and validation needs.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-26: Research 3D profilometer. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Gravimetric load cell
text: A load cell measures weight. It could help check liquid delivery or changes in a sample, within a defined accuracy range.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-27: Gravimetric load cell. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Temperature and humidity control
text: Temperature and humidity affect both biology and imaging. Proposed controls would record these conditions and flag readings outside the intended range.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-28: Temperature and humidity control. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Gas and atmosphere control
text: Some organisms need particular gas conditions. Any controlled-atmosphere module would require a suitable assay, safety design and validation.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-29: Gas and atmosphere control. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Integrated nephelometer
text: A nephelometer measures light scattered by a suspension. It could help standardise sample preparation, but its reading depends on the method and calibration.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-30: Integrated nephelometer. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Direct broth microdilution module
text: Broth microdilution measures growth at different antibiotic concentrations. Direct minimum inhibitory concentration testing is a separate proposed module, not something inferred from a plate image alone.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-31: Direct broth microdilution module. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Robotic plate queue
text: A robotic queue could move plates through the instrument. Safe handling and accurate sample identity would need to be proven before routine use.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-32: Robotic plate queue. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Purpose-built liquid handler
text: A liquid handler could dispense small volumes consistently. It would need checks for volume accuracy, contamination and failed transfers.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-33: Purpose-built liquid handler. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Power, UPS and protective devices
text: Power protection helps a system stop safely or recover after an interruption. It cannot turn missing measurements into completed results.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-34: Power, UPS and protective devices. Internal project reference.

topics.title: HEPA, UV-C and chamber hygiene
text: Air filtration and decontamination are safety design questions. Ultraviolet light needs shielding and interlocks; no sterilisation performance is claimed.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-35: HEPA, UV-C and chamber hygiene. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Barcode / RFID and identity
text: Barcodes or radio tags can help keep each sample linked to the right record. Mismatches and unreadable labels must be caught before review.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-36: Barcode / RFID and identity. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Service and calibration fixtures
text: Calibration tools help check whether an instrument still measures correctly. Service procedures would need to be documented and tested.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-37: Service and calibration fixtures. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Four software layers and BAHU/SaaS architecture
text: The proposed software separates device control, analysis, record management and user interaction. Clear boundaries help explain and troubleshoot a result.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-38: Four software layers and BAHU/SaaS architecture. Internal project reference.

topics.title: BAHU · Bio-Automation & Human User Interface
text: BAHU is the proposed operator interface for laboratory automation. It would connect people, instruments and review tasks while keeping responsibility visible.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-39: BAHU - Bio-Automation & Human User Interface. Internal project reference.

topics.title: SaaS / Hive services
text: Software services could support updates, standards and multiple instruments. These are a proposed service model, not evidence of paying customers.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-40: SaaS / Hive services. Internal project reference.

topics.title: PIMS and the digital twin
text: A plate record would link images, conditions and review history. A record is different from a model that predicts future biological behaviour.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-41: PIMS and the digital twin. Internal project reference.

topics.title: CLSI/EUCAST structured standards engine
text: Antibiotic results depend on the organism, method and correct version of interpretation rules. A standards engine would keep that rule choice traceable.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-42: CLSI/EUCAST structured standards engine. Internal project reference.

topics.title: LIMS/LIS/HIS and OEM integration
text: Laboratory and hospital systems need agreed formats to exchange information. A successful connection must preserve identity, units and result meaning.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-43: LIMS/LIS/HIS and OEM integration. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Human-in-the-loop clinical workflow
text: A qualified laboratory professional reviews the evidence and decides whether to accept or correct a result. AI assistance does not remove that responsibility.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-44: Human-in-the-loop clinical workflow. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Offline and edge operation
text: Local processing could support work with limited connectivity. Synchronisation would still need to handle interruptions and conflicting updates safely.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-45: Offline and edge operation. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Cybersecurity and software lifecycle
text: Security includes controlling access, managing updates and recording important changes. These protections would need ongoing testing throughout the product’s life.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-46: Cybersecurity and software lifecycle. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Intended clinical capability set
text: Potential clinical functions are development intentions. Each would need a clearly defined use, reference method and appropriate clinical evidence.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-48: Intended clinical capability set. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Research capability set
text: Research uses could explore growth, colony appearance and other measurements. A research observation does not automatically establish a diagnostic result.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-49: Research capability set. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Advanced R&D features
text: Advanced sensing and automation are future research tracks. Their value must be shown separately rather than assumed from the platform concept.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-50: Advanced R&D features. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Use Cases · What It Does, Who Uses It, and Why It Matters
text: Different users have different laboratory questions. This area connects possible applications with the evidence each would require.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-51: Use Cases - What It Does, Who Uses It, and Why It Matters. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Concise module summary
text: The proposed instrument is organised into modules for imaging, sensing, control and records. Each module should solve a specific workflow need.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-52: Concise module summary. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Hospital clinical microbiology AST
text: Hospital laboratories test how bacteria respond to antibiotics. An assisted workflow would need to fit existing quality systems and qualified review.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-53: Hospital clinical microbiology AST. Internal project reference.

topics.title: ICU and sepsis workflows
text: Sepsis care depends on timely, reliable clinical information. A proposed laboratory tool must not promise faster treatment decisions without supporting studies.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-54: ICU and sepsis workflows. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Antimicrobial stewardship
text: Stewardship teams work to improve antibiotic use. Validated laboratory results may support that work, alongside clinical judgement and other evidence.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-55: Antimicrobial stewardship. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Direct MIC testing
text: Minimum inhibitory concentration is the lowest tested concentration that stops visible growth under a defined method. Measuring it directly differs from measuring a clear zone on agar.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-56: Direct MIC testing. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Teaching and academic laboratories
text: Teaching laboratories could use clearly labelled examples to learn measurement, uncertainty and review. Educational demonstrations are not clinical tests.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-57: Teaching and academic laboratories. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Research phenomics
text: Phenomics studies observable traits such as growth and appearance. Those traits can be informative, but do not by themselves reveal a genome.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-58: Research phenomics. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Fluorescent reporter studies
text: Fluorescent markers can make a biological process easier to observe. Such studies require suitable organisms, equipment and experimental controls.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-59: Fluorescent reporter studies. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Heteroresistance and satellite-colony research
text: Small colonies inside or near an antibiotic zone may deserve investigation. An image alone cannot confirm heteroresistance or explain its mechanism.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-60: Heteroresistance and satellite-colony research. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Anaerobic and microaerophilic research
text: Some organisms grow with little or no oxygen. Studying them needs a controlled environment and methods suited to that biology.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-61: Anaerobic and microaerophilic research. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Biofilm and colony-morphology research
text: Biofilms and colony shapes are possible research subjects. Their appearance must not be treated as a validated species or resistance diagnosis.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-62: Biofilm and colony-morphology research. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Pharmaceutical QC and sterility monitoring
text: Pharmaceutical quality work has strict methods and acceptance criteria. Any proposed automated check would need validation for its specific purpose.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-63: Pharmaceutical QC and sterility monitoring. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Environmental monitoring
text: Environmental monitoring looks for microbial contamination in places or processes. Sampling methods and quality controls are central to interpreting the result.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-64: Environmental monitoring. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Water and coliform workflows
text: Water testing can include coliform and other microbial measurements. These methods have their own requirements and are not interchangeable with antibiotic plate testing.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-65: Water and coliform workflows. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Dairy and food microbiology
text: Food and dairy laboratories investigate microbial quality and safety. Potential instrument uses would need to match the relevant sample and test method.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-66: Dairy and food microbiology. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Veterinary and One Health applications
text: One Health connects human, animal and environmental health. Shared research questions do not remove the need to validate each laboratory application.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-67: Veterinary and One Health applications. Internal project reference.

topics.title: AMR surveillance network
text: A surveillance network could combine suitable laboratory records to study resistance patterns. The website’s map uses fixed synthetic examples, not live public-health data.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-68: AMR surveillance network. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Multi-site enterprise laboratories
text: A laboratory group may need consistent records across several sites. Access control, compatible methods and data quality would matter at every location.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-69: Multi-site enterprise laboratories. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Custom lab automation via BAHU
text: Laboratory automation could coordinate several instruments and operator steps. This remains a staged development pathway.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-70: Custom lab automation via BAHU. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Remote and offline decentralized laboratories
text: Laboratories with unreliable internet may benefit from local processing. Reliable recovery and later synchronisation would need to be tested.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-71: Remote and offline decentralized laboratories. Internal project reference.

topics.title: OEM and instrument integration
text: Connecting with other instrument makers requires agreed interfaces and testing. No commercial integration is implied by the concept.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-72: OEM and instrument integration. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Competitor and benchmark context
text: Existing instruments provide useful benchmarks for imaging, antibiotic testing and automation. Comparisons must consider intended use and published evidence.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-73: Competitor and benchmark context. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Competitive claim rules
text: A fair comparison describes what another system actually does. The project should not claim uniqueness or superiority without evidence.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-74: Competitive claim rules. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Modular product family
text: The proposed product family starts with a simpler reader and considers more capable systems later. Each step adds its own engineering and validation work.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-75: Modular product family. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Why the flagship price differs from Lite/Core/Clinical
text: A complex research workstation needs more hardware and support than a basic reader. This explains a possible cost difference, not a confirmed selling price.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-76: Why the flagship price differs from Lite/Core/Clinical. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Flagship price statement
text: Any proposed instrument price depends on a defined configuration and current supplier quotes. No final commercial price is established here.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-77: Flagship price statement. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Safety architecture
text: Safety design considers failures before they happen. Independent controls, clear warnings and safe stopping behaviour would need practical testing.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-79: Safety architecture. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Validation workstreams
text: Validation includes measurement accuracy, repeatability, biological comparisons and usability. The next stage depends on evidence, not the appearance of the prototype.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-80: Validation workstreams. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Regulatory statement
text: Regulatory requirements depend on intended use and jurisdiction. This project does not claim diagnostic clearance.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-81: Regulatory statement. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Claims that must not appear without evidence
text: Claims about accuracy, speed, clinical use or readiness need specific supporting evidence. Ambitious research should remain labelled as research.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-82: Claims that must not appear without evidence. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Development and de-risking sequence
text: A staged plan tests the most important uncertainties before adding complexity. Early milestones include a calibrated prototype, representative data and reference comparisons.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-83: Development and de-risking sequence. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Detailed flagship BOM categories and pricing assumptions
text: A parts budget groups optics, electronics, mechanics and services. Development estimates need checking against a selected configuration.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-84: Appendix A. Detailed flagship BOM categories and pricing assumptions. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Cost uncertainty and exclusions
text: Freight, exchange rates, duties, support and supplier availability can change costs. A preliminary estimate is not a purchase quote.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-85: A.1 Cost uncertainty and exclusions. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Preliminary commercial price bridge
text: A selling price must account for more than parts: manufacturing, testing, support and business costs also matter. The commercial model remains to be validated.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-86: A.2 Preliminary commercial price bridge. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Critical corrections and design requirements
text: Design reviews record assumptions that need correction or testing. Making those limits visible helps prevent an attractive concept from becoming an unsupported claim.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-87: Appendix B. Critical corrections and design requirements. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Final decision summary
text: The immediate priority is evidence for a practical first reader. More ambitious modules can follow when their need and performance are established.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record topic-89: Appendix D. Final decision summary. Internal project reference.

topics.title: RTOS and independent embedded control
text: Time-sensitive instrument controls may need their own real-time operating system. The aim is predictable control even when the main computer is busy.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-rtos: RTOS and independent embedded control. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Watchdogs, interlocks and fault-state recovery
text: Watchdogs and interlocks detect faults and help a system stop safely. Recovery must preserve sample identity and the history of unfinished work.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-faults: Watchdogs, interlocks and fault-state recovery. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Multi-plate camera gantry concept
text: A moving camera might image several plates with one optical system. Positioning accuracy, movement and repeatability would need testing.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-gantry: Multi-plate camera gantry concept. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Decontamination concept and UV safety boundaries
text: Ultraviolet decontamination is a proposed engineering study. Shielding and safety controls are essential, and cleaning effectiveness cannot be assumed.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-uv: Decontamination concept and UV safety boundaries. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Open hardware, software licensing and commercial services
text: Hardware designs, software and scientific content may have different reuse terms. Commercial services must respect those rights.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-licensing: Open hardware, software licensing and commercial services. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Educational and public-health access model
text: Education and public-health access are possible delivery goals. A sustainable model would need to balance affordability, support and quality.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-access: Educational and public-health access model. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Web app, offline reader and instrument application
text: A web interface and a real instrument application have different responsibilities. Offline instrument work would need safe storage, recovery and synchronisation.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-offline: Web app, offline reader and instrument application. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Goa diagnostic capacity and public-spending research framework
text: Understanding local laboratory needs can help guide development. Public-spending research does not establish government funding or procurement.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-spending: Goa diagnostic capacity and public-spending research framework. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Bacterial-outbreak preparedness scenarios
text: Outbreak scenarios can help plan information and laboratory workflows. They are exercises, not predictions of an actual outbreak.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-preparedness: Bacterial-outbreak preparedness scenarios. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Growth patterns, phenomics and identity limits
text: Growth and appearance are observable traits. They can guide research questions but cannot independently establish genetic identity.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-phenotype: Growth patterns, phenomics and identity limits. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Model evaluation and dataset governance
text: AI models need representative training data and independent evaluation. Checks should include uncertainty and examples unlike the training set.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-models: Model evaluation and dataset governance. Internal project reference.

topics.title: From laboratory records to governed surveillance
text: Turning laboratory results into public-health information requires quality checks and appropriate permissions. Aggregation alone does not make data reliable.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-surveillance: From laboratory records to governed surveillance. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Project history and source reconciliation
text: Project history helps explain how ideas and evidence developed. Older plans should not be mistaken for current completed work.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-history: Project history and source reconciliation. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Team roles and responsibilities
text: Different team members contribute biology, engineering, software and review. Roles describe responsibility, not proof of a completed capability.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-research-roles: Team roles and responsibilities. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Validation mode and correction provenance
text: A validation interface should preserve original observations and corrections. Changing a measurement must make any earlier approval invalid.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-validation-mode: Validation mode and correction provenance. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Unreadable images, review and recapture
text: Some images cannot support a reliable measurement. The correct response is to show the limitation and request review or recapture.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-readability: Unreadable images, review and recapture. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Bio-Vault and APEX XR: separate configuration studies
text: Bio-Vault and APEX XR are distinct configuration studies. Their drawings are concepts, not manufacturing-ready engineering files.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record research-configurations: Bio-Vault and APEX XR: separate configuration studies. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Reader V1: endpoint disk-diffusion reading
text: The first reader direction focuses on photographing endpoint disk-diffusion plates and helping people review zone measurements. The website offers a synthetic demonstration; the physical system remains in early development.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record reader-v1: Reader V1: endpoint disk-diffusion reading. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Campus and laboratory audit collaboration
text: A campus laboratory audit would map equipment, routines and unmet needs. It could inform collaboration without assuming a purchase or formal partnership.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record campus-audit: Campus and laboratory audit collaboration. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Cell-culture workflow research
text: Cell-culture research studies cells under controlled conditions. It is a separate future workflow with different methods from antibiotic plate reading.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record cell-culture: Cell-culture workflow research. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Stem-cell research workflows
text: Stem-cell workflows require specialised methods and careful controls. They are an exploratory research direction, not a current instrument capability.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record stem-cells: Stem-cell research workflows. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Organoid and tissue-model research
text: Organoids are laboratory-grown models that represent some tissue features. Supporting them would require a separate research and validation programme.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record organoids: Organoid and tissue-model research. Internal project reference.

topics.title: UTI and urine-culture workflow research
text: Urine-culture work involves sample handling, growth assessment and clinical interpretation. Potential assistance would need validation within that complete workflow.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record uti-workflow: UTI and urine-culture workflow research. Internal project reference.

topics.title: MRSA and molecular-result integration
text: Molecular tests can provide information that a plate image cannot. Linking their results requires suitable assays and reliable sample identity.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record molecular-workflow: MRSA and molecular-result integration. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Bioinformatics and phenotype–genotype research
text: Bioinformatics studies biological data, including genetic information. Connecting it to visible growth patterns requires qualified data and careful evaluation.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record bioinformatics: Bioinformatics and phenotype–genotype research. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Measured, derived, imputed and simulated data
text: A measured value, a calculated value, a prediction and a simulation are different. A useful record makes the origin of each value clear.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record plate-provenance: Measured, derived, imputed and simulated data. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Interoperability, APIs and audit trails
text: Systems need shared meanings as well as a working connection. Sample identity, units, timestamps and review history must survive data exchange.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record interoperability: Interoperability, APIs and audit trails. Internal project reference.

topics.title: System as a Service delivery model
text: System as a Service would combine equipment access with calibration, maintenance, training and support. It is a proposed delivery model, separate from a software subscription.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record system-service: System as a Service delivery model. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Privacy and access governance
text: Laboratory data need appropriate permissions, access limits and retention rules. Private project records should stay separate from public explanations.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record privacy-governance: Privacy and access governance. Internal project reference.

topics.title: Automation vocabulary with practical meaning
text: Edge AI means computing near an instrument; human-in-the-loop means qualified review. These terms describe design choices, not evidence that a whole automated laboratory is built.
topics.referenceLabel: AMReye.AI technical project record automation-glossary: Automation vocabulary with practical meaning. Internal project reference.
